Title: Azure Batch pool list usage metrics API will be retired on 30 September 2024

Body.Content:
The Azure Batch Pool list usage metrics API is being retired. From now until 30 September 2024, you can continue to use Azure Batch pool list usage metrics API without disruption. After that, the API may cease to work and return error code 400 (Bad Request) back to the client. 

Required action 

Stop using Azure Batch pool usage metrics API by 30 September 2024. 

Help and support 

If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, create a support request.
